01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: This repository contains Terraform-based infrastructure code to deploy and manage MongoDB environments across multiple stages (lab, int, prod). It follows an environment-based structure where each phase represents a deployment stage with isolated configurations. Each environment contains: - main.tf            → Core infrastructure definition - vault.tf           → Publishes database user passwords to Vault for the pipeline - variables.tf       → Input variables - outputs.tf         → Output values They are applied by the flyway-mongo task in sre-ci-concourse-tooling, from versioned files under indexes/, on the same lab - int - prod ladder as the Terraform. Each environment's index job runs after that environment's Terraform apply, and the next environment is gated on it, so prod cannot receive an index that has not already applied in lab and int. - Provision MongoDB infrastructure using Terraform - Maintain environment consistency across lab, int, and prod - Enable automated deployments via CI/CD pipelines
